epics.description: Raise the quality bar on the main Nimbus dashboard: filter state, chart layout, workspace switching, density modes, and empty states. This initiative covers the daily board experience customers open first and aims to cut p95 interaction jank on common paths.
child_summaries: Filter chips reset to default after switching workspaces
Dashboard chart legend overlaps axis labels on 1280px viewports
Workspace switcher shows stale plan tier until full page reload
Dark mode contrast fails WCAG AA on secondary dashboard metrics
Kanban column counts ignore cards moved via keyboard shortcuts
Date picker shifts one day backward in Pacific/Auckland timezone
Saved view filters apply only the first three selected components
Dashboard heatmap cells render transparent under forced colors mode
Dashboard refresh button triggers two identical network requests in Firefox
Board filter URL params are lost when opening a card in a new tab

epics.description: Make billing flows trustworthy end to end: invoices, portal sessions, usage meters, receipts, payment methods, and plan changes. Support and finance both treat billing bugs as P1 noise, so this epic groups the reliability fixes customers hit when they pay us.
child_summaries: Billing invoice PDF downloads with a blank second page
Billing portal redirect loops when the customer already has a portal session
Invoice line items show tax twice when the workspace uses reverse charge
Billing usage meter shows negative remaining seats after a plan downgrade
Billing receipt email links open the app root instead of the invoice detail
Add a read-only share link for dashboards without requiring a full seat
Surface upcoming invoice amount on the billing settings overview
Let billing admins download a usage CSV for any completed billing period
Surface trial days remaining as a non-blocking banner for workspace owners
Allow attaching a payment method without immediately changing the plan
Extract billing proration helpers into a shared package with unit coverage
Generate OpenAPI types for the billing portal session create endpoint

epics.description: Speed up and stabilize the collaborative editor: autosave correctness, mention UX, undo/redo, cursors, tables, and large paste paths. Editors are where customers spend the most continuous time; regressions here show up as silent data loss reports.
child_summaries: Notification toast stacks behind the sticky editor toolbar
Editor autosave writes the previous document revision every third save
Mention autocomplete inserts an extra space before the handle
Editor collaborative cursors jump to line zero after a paste of 500+ lines
Editor undo stack collapses multiple keystrokes into a single step after idle
Pinned comment markers disappear when the document is reopened in split view
Editor slash command menu stays open after switching to another browser tab
Editor markdown paste converts nested lists into a flat numbered list
Let editors insert collapsible callout blocks from the slash menu
Show inline diffs when two collaborators edit the same paragraph
Allow pinning an editor template as the default for new documents
Add an accessibility audit checklist panel for published documents
Add slash-command shortcuts for inserting date chips with relative offsets
Editor table column resize snaps to zero width on the last column

epics.description: Rebuild notification delivery so toasts, badges, digests, quiet hours, and preference toggles stay consistent across sessions. The goal is fewer muted workspaces and fewer duplicate digests after the midnight boundary bugs.
child_summaries: Sidebar badge count freezes after dismissing the last unread item
Notification preferences toggle reverts after navigating away within 2 seconds
Notification email subject line drops non-ASCII characters from the issue title
Notification digests duplicate events that occurred near the midnight boundary
Support keyboard-only navigation through the notification inbox
Let users snooze a notification for 1 hour, tomorrow, or next week
Let users configure quiet hours for desktop and mobile push alerts
Allow filtering the notification feed by project and event type
Allow muting notifications for a specific card until it is reassigned
Add Storybook stories for notification toast variants and stacking rules
Backfill missing notification preference rows for workspaces created before 2025
Migrate notification email templates to the shared MJML layout

epics.description: Harden login, session renewal, SSO, OAuth callbacks, MFA policy, and password reset so identity edge cases stop generating security tickets. Scope is product-auth for the web app, not the support portal subdomain.
child_summaries: Auth session cookie is not refreshed after silent token renewal
Login form submits twice if Enter is pressed while the request is in flight
SSO login fails when the IdP returns a NameID with mixed case domain
Password reset token is accepted twice if both tabs submit within 1 second
Allow workspace admins to force SSO for all new member invitations
Show password strength and common-breach checks on the signup form
Replace legacy localStorage auth tokens with the httpOnly session cookie path
Add Playwright coverage for OAuth callback deep-link restoration
OAuth callback lands on the root dashboard instead of the deep-linked board
Let admins require MFA for any role at or above editor

epics.description: Close gaps around bulk archive, CSV export and import, bulk reassignment, and shared worker test coverage. These paths are rare but high-blast-radius when they fail, and they currently lack shared fixtures.
child_summaries: Export CSV truncates multi-line description fields at 255 characters
Bulk archive leaves orphaned cards visible until the next poll cycle
Allow bulk reassignment of cards from the board multi-select toolbar
Support importing a board from a CSV with custom field mapping
Add integration tests for the bulk import worker

epics.description: Tighten REST contract behavior for pagination, validation status codes, bulk update, and search freshness. Partner integrations depend on stable error codes and cursor semantics; this epic is the correctness backlog for the public API surface.
child_summaries: Cursor pagination skips records when the sort column has duplicate values
REST API returns 500 instead of 422 for invalid ISO-8601 due dates
Bulk update endpoint accepts mixed project keys and partially commits changes
REST search returns stale results for 45 seconds after an issue is reassigned
Webhook subscription list endpoint ignores the pageSize parameter above 50
REST API CORS allowlist rejects legitimate subdomains of example.com
Webhook test delivery endpoint always returns 200 even when the target is down
Pagination total count drifts when filters include labels with special characters
REST field metadata endpoint caches deleted custom fields for the full TTL
REST API accepts empty assignee_slot strings instead of returning 400
Webhook fan-out delivers events twice when the subscription uses two endpoints
Expose a public endpoint to list webhook delivery attempts for a subscription
Add a REST filter for issues updated since a specific cursor token
Add a dry-run mode for bulk mutation endpoints that returns a change plan

epics.description: Make webhook delivery, signature rotation, DLQ handling, fan-out, and payload completeness reliable under load. Customers build automations on these events; silent dual-delivery or stale secrets burn trust faster than latency.
child_summaries: Webhook delivery retries exhaust the DLQ without surfacing a final failure event
Webhook signature header uses the previous secret for 30 seconds after rotation
SDK webhook verifier fails for payloads larger than 256 KiB
Webhook payload omits the previous status when the transition skips intermediate states
Allow webhook filters by project key and issue type without a separate subscription
Support rotating webhook secrets with a dual-validation grace period
Migrate webhook delivery logs to a partitioned cold-storage table
Add contract tests for webhook signature verification across secret rotations
Write a runbook for replaying failed webhook deliveries from the DLQ
Normalize error response envelopes across REST and webhook test endpoints
Add OpenTelemetry traces around webhook fan-out fan-in paths
Add schema validation for incoming webhook filter expressions

epics.description: Stabilize background workers: heartbeats, concurrency leases, dead-letter metadata, progress checkpoints, and queue-depth observability. Platform ops should reason about export jobs without hunting logs.
child_summaries: Worker crashes when the job payload contains nested null optional fields
Worker heartbeat expires while a long-running export holds the same lease
Worker dead-letter requeue loses the original attempt count metadata
Worker concurrency semaphore leaks slots after a panicked handler
Worker job IDs collide when two nodes boot within the same millisecond
Let workers publish progress checkpoints for multi-minute export jobs
Expose worker queue depth metrics via a read-only ops endpoint
Allow workers to pause and resume long-running jobs without losing lease state
Add integration tests for the bulk import worker pagination edge cases
Generate SDK release notes from the OpenAPI diff for each minor version
Backfill missing created_at indexes on the worker job history table
Add benchmark fixtures for the search index rebuild worker

epics.description: Improve the official SDKs so list/create/retry paths and generated types match the REST contract. Goal is fewer partner tickets that start with the docs say one thing but the client does another.
child_summaries: SDK listIssues ignores the expand=changelog query parameter on v2.4 clients
SDK createIssue drops custom field values when the field is multi-select
SDK retry middleware does not honor 503 Retry-After delay values
SDK TypeScript types mark required create fields as optional after codegen
Allow SDK consumers to stream search results via async iterators
Provide signed temporary URLs for large attachment downloads in the SDK
Let SDK clients configure a custom fetch implementation for edge runtimes
Add SDK helpers for building JQL-like filters with typed field names
Replace ad-hoc sleep retries with the shared exponential backoff package
Upgrade the SDK HTTP client to enforce TLS 1.2 minimum
Document SDK authentication flows for OAuth and API key side by side

epics.description: Fix rate-limit window math, header honesty, preflight accounting, redis key isolation, and soft-warning signals at the edge. Fair throttling protects multi-tenant clusters without surprising well-behaved clients.
child_summaries: Rate limiter window resets early under clock skew between API nodes
Rate limit headers omit Retry-After on 429 responses from the edge layer
Rate limiting counts OPTIONS preflight requests against the client quota
Rate limiter redis key collision occurs across staging and production clusters
Support soft rate-limit warnings at 80 percent of the hourly quota
Surface remaining rate-limit budget on every successful authenticated response
Document rate limit tiers and header semantics for public API consumers
Add chaos tests for rate limiter redis failover behavior
Add feature flags for the soft rate-limit warning headers experiment

epics.description: Improve how customers ask and resolve billing questions: portal invoices, proration copy, form attachments, refund macros, and routing into the Billing Questions queue. Cuts repeat tickets that bounce between support and finance.
child_summaries: Customer cannot download invoice after plan change mid-cycle
Billing question form drops the attached screenshot on mobile Safari
Support macros insert outdated refund policy text from 2025
Billing proration explanation in the portal mismatches the invoice line items
Customer cannot reopen a closed ticket from the portal within 24 hours
Billing questions route to Triage instead of Billing Questions queue

Billing refund request form rejects valid VAT IDs from certain EU countries
Customer cannot update the contact email on an open billing dispute
Billing double-charge complaint cannot link to the matching invoice ID
Customer sees another tenant workspace name briefly on portal load
Billing question about seat reduction is auto-closed after 48 hours of silence

child_summaries: Customer reports missing issues after workspace merge completed green
Triage queue sorts by last updated instead of first response SLA

Support search returns tickets from other workspaces for shared domains

Triage backlog count includes spam tickets marked for deletion

Wire support portal audit logs into the shared SIEM pipeline

epics.description: Fix escalation timers, on-call auto-assign, handoffs, and chat transcript export so high-severity tickets stay owned. Night-shift EU coverage gaps and timer resets are the recurring pain this epic targets.
child_summaries: Escalation auto-assign skips the on-call rotation for EU overnight hours
Escalation email goes to the previous owner after a handoff

Escalation severity dropdown loses the selected value on mobile web
Escalation template variables render as raw placeholders in outbound email
Customer report of data-loss after bulk archive cannot be reproduced in staging
Escalation chat transcript export truncates the last 20 messages
Escalation on-call page mute suppresses all channels instead of SMS only
Escalation secondary assignee is not notified when the primary is out of office

Create a runbook for verifying portal SSO after IdP certificate rotation
Remove retired escalation severity values from the admin UI

epics.description: Stabilize the customer-facing support portal: ticket status sync, SSO on the support subdomain, macros, reopen windows, agent draft autosave, and outage language. Portal trust is the entry point for every other support epic.
child_summaries: Support portal ticket status stuck on Waiting despite agent reply
Customer SSO login fails only on the support portal subdomain
